name: images-slider
blurb: Slides through images with auto-play and arrow-key navigation.
description: Displays a sequence of images with fade-in animations and direction-based exit transitions. Auto-advances every 5 seconds or responds to arrow keys.
use_when: Building a hero section with rotating imagery and optional overlay content.
avoid_when: Images require external fetching—all images must preload before rendering begins.
a11y: Keyboard navigation via arrow keys; no ARIA labels for images. Animation continues regardless of prefers-reduced-motion.
